title: vigil.signal/v0
description: An ephemeral, informational record. Accepted only by an authenticated POST and never consulted for overall or sources[]. POST bodies carry apiVersion, source, kind, severity and optionally note and ttl; id and created_at are assigned by the server and must be absent from a request.

source.description: Caller-defined origin label, e.g. deploy. Dots and hyphens allowed; open vocabulary, shape-checked only.

kind.description: Caller-defined event label, e.g. deploy.start. Dots and hyphens allowed; open vocabulary, shape-checked only.

severity.description: Informational only. Deliberately not the GREEN/YELLOW/RED vocabulary.

created_at.description: Server clock at acceptance, RFC 3339 UTC.

ttl.description: Lifetime in seconds. Absent means 300. A request outside 60..3600 is clamped into range before storage, so a stored document is always in range.

note.description: Free text, at most 280 bytes, no control characters (log and table injection guard). maxLength counts characters; the byte bound is enforced by the decoder.
